name: account-delete-cascade
description: Deleting a wallet account reassigns its transactions to Unassigned (accountId=null) atomically, never deletes them
body: StoreContext.deleteAccount uses a Firestore writeBatch: it sets accountId=null on every transaction with that accountId (from local `transactions` state), then deletes the account doc, committed atomically. Rationale: a transaction's signed amount counts toward totalOnHand regardless of account, so reassigning preserves both the spend history and the correct total; only the account's openingBalance leaves the total. The AddTransaction UI already supports the Unassigned state. Pattern to reuse for any future cascade in this store: derive affected docs from the already-subscribed local arrays rather than issuing a read query.
